title: Verify first name is mandatory
gherkin:
Feature: User Registration
  Scenario: First name field is mandatory
    Given I am on the registration page
    When I submit the registration form without entering a first name
    Then I should see an error message indicating that the first name is required
rationale: To ensure that the first name field is enforced as a mandatory field during registration.
generationSummary: Tests for verifying the mandatory fields required during user registration.
